subject: Question about different result between methRead and processBismarkAln

messages.author: e39dd39f7c58fcfe
messages.subject: Question about different result between methRead and processBismarkAln
parts:
Dear Altuna,

I am a Ph.D. candidate from Central South University. Nowadays I used the methylKit to perform WGBS data analysis.

I used the processBismarkAln function to read a bam file with "nolap=TRUE". I also used methRead function to read a bismarkCytosineReport file which got from the bam file. But I got different results of the total CpG. I got 11077272 rows while when read bam and got 11559081 rows when read report file. 

Why did I get the different results? I performed filter using trim_galore before bismark and extracted methylation using bismark with "no-overlap". Beg for your help. Thank you. 

Best,

--
--
Wang Kangli
State Key Laboratory of Medical Genetics, Changsha, Hunan, China.

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: Question about different result between methRead and processBismarkAln
parts:
two methods might not be identical, we use read count cutoff and base quality cutoffs I'm not sure if they are used in the same way in both methylation extraction methods. 

you can check the CpGs that only exist in one set and see if they have some differences in read counts or base quality. 

Best
